title: Before waiting, ask
body: Everything so far assumes the payer goes looking for their bill. A Request to Pay is the platform asking instead — addressed to a phone number, carrying its own lifecycle, with every step recorded.

title: Fourteen requests, in eight different states
body: Sent, delivered, presented, accepted, declined, expired, cancelled, undeliverable. A request is a conversation that can end several ways, and an agency needs to see which ended how.

title: Request R260005, for PKR 16,500.00
body: Delivered to the payer's phone, not yet opened.

title: The payer opens it
body: Presented — it is now in front of them.

title: And accepts — which is not the same as paying
body: Accepting is the payer agreeing. No money has moved. The bill is still outstanding, and the request will sit here until it is actually settled.
